title: Abakhi Bemibhoshongo
intro: Esikhathini eside esidlule, impucuko enamandla yavela, yahlukaniswa ngemisebenzi yayo emangalisayo yokwakha kanye namandla amakhulu. Lo mbuso ohlangene wanikezwa izinsiza eziningi kanye nobuchule obungokomzimba, kodwa bakhetha indlela yokuphikisa umyalezo waphezulu othunyelwe ukubaqondisa. Indaba yabo isebenza njengesifundo esijulile emlandweni, ubufakazi bemiphumela yokwenqaba iqiniso.
clues: Sanikwa amandla amakhulu omzimba kanye nobukhulu, ngokungafani nanoma yibaphi abanye abantu besikhathi sethu.
Sasaziwa ngokwakha izakhiwo ezinkulu nezinsika eziphakeme kuzo zonke izindawo eziphakeme, sicabanga ukuthi sizophila phakade.
Isithunywa esivela kithi sathunyelwa ukuzosixwayisa, sisibizela ukuba sikhonze u-Allah kuphela futhi sishiye izithixo zethu.
Sabuza isithunywa sethu ngokuzidla, sibuza ukuthi ngabe beze kithi ukuzosenza sikhulekele u-Allah futhi silahle lokho okwakukhonzwa okhokho bethu.
Izwe lethu lalibusiswe ngezingadi, imithombo, namasimu avundile, kodwa sathi ukuchuma kwethu kungenxa yamandla ethu, hhayi uMdali wethu.
Ngenxa yokungakholwa kwethu okuqhubekayo kanye nokuhlekwa usulu, ekugcineni sabhujiswa umoya owesabekayo nonamandla owavunguza izinsuku eziningi nobusuku.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
